cover.headline: ChatGPT's agents can pay now. Spending limits *come later*.
cover.sub: Every purchase waits for Face ID or a fingerprint. Five moves from 13 Nov that change a builder's week, plus two free courses.

items.title: ChatGPT's agents can now *check out* for you
items.statLabel: card numbers the agent or the merchant sees. It pays with a token
items.what: ChatGPT Wallet opened on 13 Nov to some US Pro users with US cards, built with Amex, Mastercard and Visa. Each purchase needs Face ID or a fingerprint.
items.why: No spending limits yet. OpenAI asks merchants to verify its cloud browser with Web Bot Auth and tune fraud rules to pass real agent checkouts.

items.title: Gemini can read Google Wallet, *not spend from it*
items.statLabel: that Gemini can move from your accounts. It has read access only
items.what: Since 13 Nov, US Gemini users can connect Google Wallet and Plaid-linked bank and card accounts, then ask about spending, subscriptions and budgets.
items.why: Claude's finance beta drew the same line on 5 Nov. Reading transactions is turning into a free assistant feature. Moving money is the licensed part.

items.title: A key Cursor gave Fireworks led to a *poisoned extension*
items.statLabel: users, at most, may have received the tampered Claude Code build
items.what: The key opened stored agent traces, mostly from 2025. Some held unredacted credentials, and one let the attacker plant a backdoored extension on 29 Oct.
items.why: Agent logs hold whatever the agent touched. Redact secrets before traces are stored, and give each vendor its own scoped key you can revoke fast.

items.title: Cloudflare caps now *pause* Workers at a hard limit
items.statLabel: at most before spend shows on the dashboard. Blocking comes after
items.what: Spend Management went into beta on 13 Nov for pay-as-you-go accounts: a limit per product, email alerts, and an automatic pause at the cap.
items.why: Cloudflare warns recorded spend can exceed a limit, so size caps for the overrun. Model calls need AI Gateway budgets, a separate control.

items.title: The Fed's survey now ranks AI the *top-cited risk*
items.statLabel: of advanced-computing debt issuance by October 2026, per the Fed
items.what: AI led the risks named by 23 market contacts in the Fed's November report. The largest US banks have close to $1 trillion of related exposure.
items.why: The Fed says reports of agentic systems in cyber events have risen since May. If you sell to banks, expect reviews of what your agents can touch.

coursesTitle: Two free courses, one on *agent payments*

courses.title: Agentic Payments: How AI Agents Move Money
courses.note: A 60-minute recorded lesson from 23 Sep on ACP, AP2, x402 and card-network agent identity, plus a way to rank a payments roadmap.

courses.title: Build and Train a GLM-5.3-Flash Model From Scratch
courses.note: freeCodeCamp, 44 minutes, posted 14 Nov. Sparse attention, mixture of experts, vision tokens and RL rewards, in Python.

readTitle: Treat every agent like a new *cardholder*
read: Payments teams already know the controls: a *token*, a step-up check, a *spending cap*, a log and fast revocation. ChatGPT shipped the token and the check on 13 Nov. The cap is still a plan, and Cursor's breach shows what an unscrubbed *agent log* costs.
takeaway: Before an agent spends or holds a key, cap it, scrub its logs and scope the key.
